sample_unit: ChatGPT answers (5 conditions x 5 raters x 5 days)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT diagnoses across days and raters
links.effect: Reproducibility between days was 1.0, 0.15, 0.7, 0.6, 0.6 for CTS, CM, LSS, KOA, HOA; between raters 1.0, 0.1, 0.64, -0.12, 0.04.
links.quote: The reproducibility between days was 1.0, 0.15, 0.7, 0.6, and 0.6 for CTS, CM, LSS, KOA, and HOA, respectively.

links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT answers recommended seeking medical attention and strength of recommendation
links.effect: 7 of 125 answers had no recommendation to seek medical attention; only a few had strong recommendation (essential 4/125, recommended 12/125, best 6/125, important 94/125).
links.quote: Additionally, 7 out of the 125 answers did not include a recommendation to seek medical attention.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT for common orthopedic conditions
links.effect: Correct answers 25/25 CTS, 1/25 CM, 24/25 LSS, 16/25 KOA, 17/25 HOA; 23/25 incorrect for CM.
links.quote: The ratios of correct answers were 25/25, 1/25, 24/25, 16/25, and 17/25 for CTS, CM, LSS, KOA, and HOA, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic accuracy, reproducibility, and medical consultation advice for orthopedic symptom queries in an offline simulation without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
